title: ganglion.yaml
description: ganglion.yaml: everything an operator chooses (spec 7.14, ADR-0059). Secrets appear only as env:NAME or store:NAME. The Go loader settings.Parse is the validator; this schema is for editors, docs and the agent. Every section has a default, so a missing or empty file is a working node.

log.description: Where and how much the node logs.

http.description: The node's public listener: the one entry the outside world has to the node.

sandbox.description: What the command sandbox hides and denies.

models.description: The models by purpose. Missing means the agent is off: there is no model to talk to.

destinations.description: Names for the conversations a message may be sent to besides the one it answers: a module's notify_to and message.send use them. Missing means none; the node writes this list when the admin names a destination (R-CFG-12).

modules.description: The modules the node runs and their configuration. Missing means none; module.install writes this list (M4b).

mcp.description: The remote MCP servers the admin connected from the chat, and the intake page's address (R-MCP-2). It applies at once; mcp.connect, mcp.rule and /mcp write it, config.propose never does.

memory.description: The agent's long-term memory by topic (M5, R-MEM-6–9).

update.description: How the node follows the core releases (R-UPD-6).

backup.description: The daily encrypted backup to an S3-compatible bucket (R-BAK-4). Missing means backups are off. Only the host edits this section: the agent cannot change it.

endpoint.description: The bucket's S3 endpoint: an https address with a host and no path, such as https://s3.example.com.

region.description: The signing region the provider names (R2 takes auto).

bucket.description: The bucket's name. The bucket is addressed path-style, as endpoint/bucket/key.

prefix.description: The folder in the bucket the archives go to. Empty puts them at the top of the bucket.

access_key_id.description: The id of the access key. Give the key the right to write into this bucket and nothing else: no right to delete.

secret_access_key.description: The access key's secret, as env:NAME or store:NAME. It is never written in the file.

at.description: The time of day, in node.tz, the backup runs at: HH:MM. Without it, 03:00.

check.description: Ask once a day for a newer release and tell the admins once per version. It never installs one. Off, the node does not ask.

prompt_budget.description: The size in characters of the known-facts block of an admin's system prompt. Every topic is shown whole while they fit; over it, the topics changed longest ago fold to one line and are read with memory.read. off (0) folds every topic.

review.description: The pass that reads a quiet conversation once for facts the turn did not store (R-MEM-8).

enabled.description: Run the review. Off, only the agent's own writes in a turn store facts.

quiet.description: How long the owner's private chat is silent before it is reviewed; the end of a session reviews it at once. Must be above 0 while enabled.

secretRef.description: A secret by reference: env:NAME reads the variable NAME, or the file named by NAME_FILE; store:NAME reads NAME among the node's own secrets in its secret store (ganglion secret set NAME). A literal secret is refused.

duration.description: A Go duration such as 90s or 6h, or off (0).

count.description: A whole number of 0 or more, or off (0).

money.description: US dollars, 0 or more, or off (0).

size.description: A byte size such as 400MiB; a bare number is bytes.

memory_limit.description: The node's soft memory limit (GOMEMLIMIT). Without it the node takes about 80 % of its container's limit, or none. Set it when the container is sized for module builds. A GOMEMLIMIT set in the environment wins.

tz.description: The IANA time zone that decides where a day starts (daily limits, schedules).

dir.description: The directory of the rotated log files. Missing puts them in a logs directory beside the database; off writes no files (the log still goes to stderr).

addr.description: The listen address host:port of the Prometheus endpoint; off runs no endpoint.

The listen address host:port of the public listener; off runs none. It serves plain HTTP and expects a proxy that ends TLS in front. It carries the Telegram webhook and a health route, and is never the metrics endpoint.

public_url.description: The HTTPS address the outside world reaches the listener at, such as https://ganglion.example.com: no path, and no port or one of 443, 80, 88 and 8443. The node checks at start that this address reaches it.

token.description: The bot token, as env:NAME or store:NAME. Without it set the Telegram transport does not start.

api_url.description: The Bot API's base address; change it for a local Bot API server or a test double.

admin.description: The principal that is admin from the first start, as telegram:user:<id>. Missing seeds no admin.

updates.description: How updates arrive: polling (the node asks Telegram) or webhook (Telegram calls the public listener; needs http.addr and http.public_url). Applies at the next start.

reply.description: When an answer quotes the message it answers: auto (in a group, or when newer messages came after it), always, or off (never).

rich.description: Turn the agent's Markdown into Telegram formatting; false sends plain text.

reactions.description: The bot's reaction to a message while it works.

groups.description: The group chats whose members may talk to the bot; in a group it answers only when addressed. Missing means none; the node writes a line when the admin allows a group (R-DLV-17).

after.description: How long a turn runs before the bot first reacts to the message; off means it never reacts.

dwell.description: How long a reaction stays before the next one replaces it.

workspace.description: The directory of the agent's files (persona, memory); must not be empty.

languages.description: The directory of the language files. Missing puts them beside the database.

session_idle.description: The silence after which a conversation starts afresh; off never starts afresh by silence.

call_timeout.description: How long one model call may take. On the claude CLI route one call runs every tool call of its turn. Above 0 and not longer than turn_timeout.

turn_timeout.description: How long a whole turn may take. The node's handler gets a minute more, which must stay below the queue's lease of 10m, so at most just under 9m.

max_steps.description: How many model calls one turn may make. Tool listing and turning on (mcp.tools, mcp.use) do not spend it.

limits.description: What one day of conversation may use. The word off turns every limit off; a missing key keeps the default of that limit, and 0 or off in a limit turns that one off.

search.description: The web search the agent may use.

daily_budget_usd.description: The most US dollars of model cost a day; 0 or off is no cap.

daily_turns.description: The most turns a day; 0 or off is no cap.

daily_tokens.description: The most tokens a day; 0 or off is no cap.

mode.description: auto uses web search when a search key is set; off gives the agent no search.

brave_key.description: The Brave Search API key, as env:NAME or store:NAME. With it unset, search is unavailable in auto mode.

deny.description: Extra paths the command sandbox refuses, on top of its built-in list. Missing adds none.

hide_names.description: Hide the names of denied paths too, so a listing does not show they exist.

providers.description: The model providers the node calls.

models.description: The providers' models that the purposes may name.

purposes.description: For each purpose, the models it tries in order.

name.description: How the models name this provider.

type.description: openai is the Chat Completions API (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, ...); claude-cli is an unmodified claude -p (ADR-0021). Missing means openai.

base_url.description: An openai provider's API address, such as https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

key.description: The API key, as env:NAME or store:NAME. Only a provider on localhost goes without one; claude-cli takes none.

command.description: The claude-cli binary. Missing means claude on the PATH.

id.description: How the purposes name the model. Missing means name.

provider.description: The name of the provider that serves the model.

name.description: The provider's own name for the model.

tools.description: The model can call tools; the agent needs this of a chat model.

local.description: The data stays on the owner's hardware.

context.description: The model's context window in tokens. Missing means unknown.

price_in.description: US dollars per million input tokens; 0 or missing for local and subscription models.

price_out.description: US dollars per million output tokens; 0 or missing for local and subscription models.

latency_ms.description: The model's typical latency in milliseconds. Missing means unknown.

effort.description: The reasoning effort. Missing leaves the provider's default. An openai provider takes low, medium and high; claude-cli takes all five.

purposes.description: Each purpose lists its models in the order they are tried. A missing check, compact or translate uses chat's list; a missing memory uses check's; a missing code means no code model.

chat.description: The model that answers the owner; required when models is set.

check.description: The memory check after a turn. Missing uses chat's list.

compact.description: Compaction of a long conversation. Missing uses chat's list.

translate.description: Translation of the node's own messages. Missing uses chat's list.

memory.description: The memory review of a quiet conversation (R-MEM-8). Missing uses check's list.

code.description: Writing module code. Missing means none: the node does not write code.

name.description: How the admin and a module's line call it; owner is reserved for the module owner's private chat.

conv.description: The conversation's key, such as telegram:-1001234567890/45 for topic 45 of a forum.

chat.description: Telegram's id of the group, a negative number.

name.description: For people: the group's title when it was connected.

role.description: What the group's members may do: family, which is conversation with no tools.

page.description: The address of the intake page, where a sign-in comes back and a secret is typed; the node checks it against its own copy before every request (R-INT-3).

servers.description: The connected servers by name: 1 to 24 of a-z, 0-9 and _, not a module's short name.

url.description: The server's Streamable HTTP address: https, a public host, no user info.

auth.description: How the node signs in: none, oauth (a sign-in in the browser) or header (a key in a header).

header.description: For auth: header, the header that carries the key; the key is in the secret store, scope mcp:<name>.

timeout.description: How long one request may take, such as 30s.

tools.description: The policy of each approved tool, by its name without the server's prefix: auto runs by itself, confirm asks first, forbidden is never offered.

fingerprint.description: The pin of the approved tool list: when the server's list changes, its tools are off until the admin approves again (R-MCP-7).

config.description: The module's own settings, checked against its manifest. Missing means none.

off.description: Keep the module installed but not running.

notify_to.description: Where the module's messages go: owner (the private chat of its owner) or names under destinations, each message to every one. Missing means the owner alone (R-RUN-18).
